⚡ SearchPulse AI — Google Search Console Intelligence Platform

Evidence-Based SEO Decisioning, Traffic Drop Diagnostics, Content Decay Recovery & Revenue Optimization

Developed by Muhammad Hamid — Head of Digital Marketing & MarTech Engineering Specialist with 7+ years of experience scaling search revenue, healthcare networks, BPOs, and e-commerce brands.
Direct Inquiries / Project Hiring: 💬 +92 316 7417135 (WhatsApp Direct)

--- ## 🎯 Executive Problem Statement Standard Google Search Console (GSC) is great at reporting raw search metrics, but terrible at telling marketing heads and website owners **what to do next**: 1. **Deceptive Arithmetic Averages**: Averaging CTR percentages across queries produces mathematically flawed numbers that disguise revenue opportunities. 2. **Unexplained Traffic Collapses**: When organic traffic drops 30%, GSC displays a downward graph line without diagnosing whether the drop was caused by SERP competitor displacement, AI Overview cannibalization, seasonality, or a technical 404/noindex error. 3. **Silent Content Decay**: High-performing cornerstone articles slowly bleed rankings over 6–12 months without automated alerting. 4. **Keyword Cannibalization Waste**: Multiple URLs split clicks and impression share for the same keyword topic, depressing both URLs from entering the top 3. **SearchPulse AI** solves this by converting raw Google Search Analytics API payloads into **prioritized, evidence-backed sprint tickets** that directly translate to organic traffic and revenue growth. --- ## 🚀 Core Features & Capabilities ### ⚡ Feature A: High-Precision Search Performance Dashboard - **True Mathematical Aggregation**: Calculates aggregate CTR as $\frac{\sum \text{Clicks}}{\sum \text{Impressions}} \times 100$ rather than averaging percentages. - **Impression-Weighted Average Position**: Ranks weighted by visual SERP exposure. - **Period-over-Period Delta Analysis**: Real-time comparisons (Last 28 Days vs Prior 28 Days, or 90-Day windows) with absolute and percentage shifts. - **Daily Time-Series Trajectory**: Visual trajectory mapping clicks against impression momentum. ### 🎯 Feature B: Keyword Opportunity Finder - Compares real-world keyword CTR against an empirical **SERP Position Expected CTR curve**. - Identifies striking-distance keywords (Positions 2 through 15) with high impressions (>100) and below-expected CTR. -
